why: us03: types are UpperCamel and fields lowerCamel, so a type and a field with an underscore are each reported at their declaration. TypeScript's form has the type and no field: a TypeScript property's name is its wire key, with no tag or CodingKeys to hold a different wire spelling, so a hand-written mirror can't be told from a defect, and property names are not judged there (P2)
